text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated error rate and tail latency observed in dedicated pool 'zen-3' impacting Lyric tenant traffic. Paging on-call: @sarah_prod

sarah_prod: ack. I'm on it. Any initial customer impact numbers?

mike_eng: seeing 502/504 spikes and queue growth starting ~08:12 UTC. Scope: ~30% of Lyric requests failing, increased p95 from 120ms -> 1.8s. Logs point to KV cache pressure and OOM churn on worker nodes.

raj_sre: adding context — noisy tenant 'lyric-tenant-42' causing heavy long-context requests, lots of KV cache misses. Suggest isolating tenant and throttle new requests while we stabilize.

olga_se: I'm on standby to draft CS message. Customer-facing message should call out degraded performance and immediate mitigation steps; ask for permission for a short redirect to hosted fallback if they'd accept.

ben_ops: putting isolation plan into motion now. Command I'll run:

```bash
rbctl tenant throttle --tenant lyric-tenant-42 --rate 10rps --pool zen-3
rbctl tenant isolate --tenant lyric-tenant-42 --pool zen-3 --drain --timeout 60s
```

mike_eng: running the throttle now. Noting that draining will move KV state; expect ~30s to see reduced error rate.

sarah_prod: :white_check_mark: throttle applied. Error rate falling but latency still a bit high on a subset. Proceed with isolate/drain when ready.

ben_ops: isolate/drain started. Monitoring.

raj_sre: after isolation we should spin a temporary hotfix: increase KV cache size on remaining nodes and restart 1 pod at a time to reclaim memory. I'll own the rollout.

mike_eng: after isolate + cache bump p95 back to ~220ms, errors down to <1%. Looks stable so far.

olga_se: CS draft: "Hi Lyric team — we identified a noisy tenant workload affecting your dedicated pool. We've isolated the offending tenant and applied mitigations; service has been restored. We're preparing a short RCA and will propose credits. If you want immediate traffic failover to our hosted endpoints while we do a deeper remediation, we can arrange it." Thoughts?

alice_cs: LGTM. Recommend offering 3 days of service credit or a 20% billing credit for impacted period. We'll escalate if exec asks for more.

jamie_ceo: please prepare an exec one-pager for Lyric leadership. Include timeline, root cause (noisy long-context KV pattern), mitigation steps, and proposed credits. I want the ask approved before sending.

sarah_prod: handing incident to raj_sre for long-term fixes and RCA. I'll update the incident ticket and close the on-call bridge.

oncall-bot: Bridge closed by sarah_prod. Incident severity set to SEV2 -> stabilised.

(24h later)
sarah_prod: Shared RCA draft here: https://docs.internal/rcas/1755055050-lyric-draft — please review, especially the root cause writeup and mitigation timeline.

raj_sre: reviewed. Added notes about kvcache eviction thresholds and suggested a permanent tenant throttling policy for long-context workloads.

alice_cs: scheduled a call with Lyric for tomorrow 14:00 PST to review RCA and credit proposal. I've drafted the customer email and exec summary; will attach once Raj's updates land.

jamie_ceo: thanks team. For credits I'd approve 4 days or equivalent invoice % if CS recommends. Keep me looped on exec invite.

olga_se: will send customer comms after final RCA sign-off.

alice_cs: final note — customer accepted hosted fallback for in-flight traffic during mitigation window. They're asking for a short SLA addendum for noisy-tenant handling. I'll draft language and loop legal if needed.

ben_ops: adding post-incident follow-up ticket for automation: detect long-context KV churn patterns -> auto-throttle candidate tenants and surface to CS.

sarah_prod: thanks everyone — closing thread once RCA doc updated.
